listing.name: Guarantee Rare Items
listing.summary: This ensures that there is one salvageable instance of every special colony item in the whole sector upon sector generation. They'll be scattered across Research Stations, Mining Stations, and Orbital Habitats.
listing.aiSummary: Ensures one salvageable instance of every special colony item exists in the sector upon generation.

description:
Guarantee Rare Items

Download
Github

Requires LazyLib and MagicLib

Now compatible with Version Checker.

This ensures that there is one salvageable instance of every special colony item in the whole sector upon sector generation. They'll be scattered across Research Stations, Mining Stations, and Orbital Habitats.

Won't do anything for old saves, because it only adds the salvage during sector generation.

Comes with Industrial Evolution compatibility and JSON configuration. You can add or remove specific items and other salvage types by editing modSettings.json.

aiDescription: Guarantees that a single salvageable copy of each special colony item is scattered across Research Stations, Mining Stations, and Orbital Habitats when the sector is generated. This effect only applies to new games, as it does not modify existing saves. The mod includes compatibility with Industrial Evolution and allows users to customize which items and salvage types are affected by editing a JSON configuration file.
